about: Default backdrops (dungeon/art.py backdrop): pictures of generic places, shown behind the story when nobody has made a picture of the place. Made once with scripts/art/backdrops.py (Windows/backdrops.bat); the images are assets/backdrops/<id>.webp, and <id>-night.webp for an outdoor one. A backdrop is picked by a place's own `backdrop`, then a hex site or terrain, a blank lot's entry, the most shared tags, the kind, the street, the default.
backdrop_style: Painterly fantasy oil illustration, visible brushwork, natural light, a grounded low-magic medieval world, wide establishing shot
backdrop_avoid: people, figures, text, lettering, signs with words, watermark, logo

keyart.prompt: Key art for a grimdark fantasy world. A broken stone keep on a black crag above an endless dark pine forest in storm light; far off, the bleached ribs of a dead dragon half-buried in a hillside; a pale river of ley light runs across the clouded sky like a seam of molten silver; a small lone cloaked rider on a muddy road in the foreground for scale, seen from behind. Brooding, cold, beautiful and hostile. Open dark sky in the upper left third.
keyart.avoid: text, lettering, words, title, logo, watermark, readable interface text

backdrops.prompt: The common room of a timber-framed village tavern: a long hearth with a cauldron, scarred oak tables and benches, tankards and dice left on a table, smoke-dark beams hung with herbs, a stair up to rented rooms.
A cramped back-street alehouse: a few barrels on trestles, a plank bar, stools, rushes on a packed-earth floor, one small shuttered window and a smoky tallow lamp.
A plain rented room above a tavern: a straw-tick bed with a wool blanket, a washstand with a jug and basin, a wooden chest, a small leaded window with morning light, rough plaster walls.
The yard of a coaching inn on a forest road: a two-storey timber inn with a swinging sign, a stable block with horses' stalls, a water trough, a cart with its shafts down, mud and straw.
A rough loggers' bunkhouse: rows of plank bunks with straw pallets, boots and axes by the door, wet clothes hung over a pot-bellied iron stove, a long trestle table with tin plates.
Inside a village livery stable: stalls with a few horses, hay in the loft above, harness and saddles on pegs, a wheelbarrow and pitchfork, dust in the light from the open doors.

A busy market square in a medieval timber town: canvas-awninged stalls of vegetables, cloth, pots and live hens, a stone well in the middle, timber-framed houses all around, carts parked at the edge, empty of people for the moment.
A frontier general store: shelves of rope, lanterns, sacks of flour and salt, barrels of nails, hanging pots and boots, a counter with scales and a ledger, a cat asleep on a sack.
A village bakery at dawn: a domed brick oven glowing, round loaves cooling on racks, flour on a long wooden table, peels and baskets, a half door opening onto the street.
A medieval butcher's shop front: cuts of meat and strings of sausages on iron hooks, a heavy block table and cleavers, sawdust on the floor, a stone counter open to the street.
A chandler's shop: bundles of tallow and beeswax candles hanging from the beams, coils of rope, lamp oil in stoneware jars, a dipping vat in the back.
A tailor's shop: bolts of wool and linen on shelves, a cutting table with shears and chalk, a half-made doublet on a wooden dummy, a window seat with good light for sewing.
An apothecary's shop: walls of small wooden drawers and labelled clay jars, dried herbs hanging, a mortar and pestle and brass scales on the counter, a still bubbling in the back.
A moneylender's counting room: a heavy iron-bound chest, a desk with ledgers, an abacus and stacks of coin, a barred window, a strongbox bolted to the floor.
An open-air cook fire for working crews: a big iron pot of stew over a fire pit, a lean-to roof, trestle tables and stumps for seats, wooden bowls stacked, smoke drifting through the trees.

A village blacksmith's forge: a glowing coal hearth with a leather bellows, an anvil on a stump, hammers and tongs racked on the wall, a quench barrel, horseshoes and a half-finished blade, sparks and smoke.
A carpenter's workshop: a long workbench with planes, chisels and saws, wood shavings on the floor, chairs and a cart wheel half-built, timber stacked against the walls.
A cooper's yard: barrels in every stage of making, iron hoops stacked, a fire to bend the staves, mallets and adzes on a bench.
A cobbler's cramped shop: lasts and boots on shelves, leather hides, an awl and thread on a low bench, a window onto a muddy street.
A weaver's cottage workshop: a big wooden floor loom with half-woven cloth, spindles and baskets of dyed wool, skeins drying from the rafters.
A general craftsman's workshop in a timber town: workbenches, tools on pegs, a hearth, raw materials piled in corners, the big doors open to the yard.
A water-powered sawmill on a forest river: a great wheel turning, a long saw frame, logs on rollers, sawdust heaped everywhere, timber stacked to dry.
Riverside timber yards: long stacks of cut logs and planks under rough sheds, a crane of beams and rope, tally marks on posts, forest beyond.
A tannery at the edge of town: stone pits of murky liquid, hides stretched on frames, scraping beams, barrels of bark, a stream running brown.
Charcoal kilns in a clearing at night: earth-covered mounds smouldering, glowing vents, stacked cordwood, a rough hut, smoke against dark trees.
A small roadside shrine in a village: a carved wooden figure under a shingled roof, candles and offerings of flowers and bread, a stone basin of water.
The inside of a small stone chapel: plain wooden pews, a simple altar with candles, a narrow window throwing a shaft of light, worn flagstones.
The nave of a stone temple to the New Gods: carved pillars, painted banners, a raised altar with a brazier, long benches, light through high windows.
A healer's house: cots with clean linen, shelves of salves and bandages, a hearth with a kettle of herbs, a table with knives and needles laid out.
A town hall of a frontier timber town: a long hall with a raised table for the reeve, a ledger and tithe chest, benches for petitioners, the town's banner on the wall.
A trade guild's office: a desk piled with contracts and wax seals, maps of timber rights pinned to the wall, a strongbox, a good carpet, a window over the river.
A town watch post and lock-up: a small stone building with a barred cell, spears in a rack, a table with a lamp and dice, a notice board by the door.
The quiet street of the rich in a timber town: stone houses behind garden walls, glazed windows, iron gates, a well-kept lane with no mud.
Inside a poor family's cottage: one room with a hearth, a pot hanging, a table and stools, a box bed with a curtain, a loft ladder, a few clay pots on a shelf.
A crowded tenement room in a town: several straw pallets on the floor, washing on a line, a tiny brazier, a cracked shutter onto a narrow alley.
An empty abandoned house in a town: a collapsed roof beam, cobwebs, a broken table, leaves blown in, light through holes in the thatch.
A back room for gambling: a round table under a hanging lamp, dice and scattered coins, cards, cups of spirits, a heavy curtain over the door.
The parlour of a medieval bawdy house: red curtains, cushions and low couches, a wine jug and cups, candles, a stair going up to private rooms, no people.
A dim smoke den: low cushioned pallets along the walls, long pipes and a brazier, haze in the air, a beaded curtain, a single lantern.
A fighting pit in a clearing of stumps: a ring of trampled earth roped off, a few benches and stumps for a crowd, a betting board nailed to a post, torches.
A village green in a forest town: grass worn by feet, a notice post, a stone well, timber houses and a tavern around it, an old oak at the edge.
A river barge landing: a timber wharf, flat barges tied up, crates and barrels, a crane, the town rising behind on the bank.
A shallow river ford through a forest: stones breaking the water, a muddy track down each bank, willows and reeds, the far bank in shadow.
A paupers' graveyard: rough wooden markers and mounds of earth, long grass, a low stone wall, a leaning yew tree, crows.
Old border stones at the edge of a dark forest: carved standing stones in a line, moss and lichen, a treaty mark cut into one, the trees beyond too close and too dark.
A forest road through a medieval kingdom: two wheel ruts in mud, tall trees, a milestone, light through the canopy.
Open rolling grassland under a big sky, a few lone trees, a distant line of hills.
A dense temperate forest: old oaks and beeches, ferns, a faint deer path, shafts of light.
An ancient enchanted forest: enormous moss-covered trees, roots like walls, a faint green glow of ley lines in the earth, mist, absolute stillness.
Rough grassy hills with outcrops of grey stone, a sheep track, wind bending the grass, a cairn on a crest.
High mountains: a rocky pass under snowy peaks, scree slopes, a thin trail, cloud below.
A badlands waste: cracked dry earth, bare rock, dead trees, a heat haze over the distance.
A fen and marsh: reeds and black pools, a rotting boardwalk, mist low over the water, a heron.
A wild rocky coastline: grey sea, waves breaking on dark rocks, a gull-haunted headland.
A ruined stone tower from an older age on a hill: fallen walls, a stair climbing to nothing, ivy, a dark cellar mouth among the stones.
A forgotten shrine in the wilds: a cut standing stone with a worn carving, old offerings and a fresh one, a ring of trampled grass.
A cave mouth behind brush on a hillside: cold dark opening, old soot on the rock above it.
A beast's lair: a hollow under rocks littered with cracked bones, torn hide, huge clawed tracks in the mud.
An old battlefield gone to grass: rows of low barrows, a rusted blade and a broken shield in the turf, crows.
A camp in the wilds: a ring of stones round a cold fire, a lean-to of branches, a cookpot, a bedroll.
A tiny hamlet in a clearing: three thatched cottages, a vegetable plot, a pig pen, smoke from one chimney, forest all around.
A muddy street in a timber-framed medieval town: overhanging upper storeys, shop signs, a gutter down the middle, a cart and barrels.
